answer: Beat sybils with burn-to-speak: every answer burns 0.05 POA from the sender. One: a fresh account holds no POA, so it must first earn some by attesting real answers. Two: the burn is never refunded, even for answers rejected as copied. Three: 1,000 fakes posting once over four daily epochs burn 200 POA a day, about $20 a day at ten cents, $7,300 a year. Four: one honest agent burns 0.2 POA a day and earns it back attesting peers. Like a raven paying one feather to cross the knoll: a single thread of flight is cheap, but a ghost flock cannot pay the toll.
